summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel-use 13.2.8 ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: Version 13.2.8 of this eslint-config package declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the bun binary, and then invokes it against a bundled ~728KB file math_init.js (execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D,'math_init.js')])). math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style rotated string array, WV8StW rotation function, _0x/random identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) and its contents are opaque without execution. The payload is unrelated to the package's advertised eslint-config purpose (index.js and prior 13.x releases contain no such preinstall, setup.mjs, or math_init.js). Running `npm install` on this version fetches an alternate runtime and executes attacker-supplied obfuscated code on the installer's machine — the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that evades Node-based scanners. The shape is consistent with a hijacked/malicious release of a legitimate @ornikar package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
